notes:
Theme lineage, the work queue, and a demo workspace.

Theme lineage: a new per-project graph showing how one idea led to another,
laid out along a real time axis. Node size is how much effort a theme drew,
fill shows how recently it was touched, and dashed edges mark relationships
the evidence supports only weakly.

Work queue: tasks enter a queue and route to the right worker, with pause and
resume and crash recovery.

Shipped view: what actually landed, over time.

Demo workspace: run "dashy demo" for a seeded workspace to explore without
touching your own notes.

Model settings: bring your own model, configured per provider.

Also in this release: a dashboard configuration viewer, and a fix for
project-scoped dashboard settings never reloading until restart.
